description: Report all invoices, including those without line items (count 0), ranked by how many line items they have.

c.request: For each invoice, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and how many line items it has. Give the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest. Report all invoices, including those without line items (count 0), ranked by how many line items they have.
c.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number LIMIT 10;

d.request: Show every invoice, including invoices with no line items, with the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and the line-item count; rank invoices by line-item count from most to fewest and return the top 10.
d.sql:
SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
GROUP BY i.invoice_number
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number
LIMIT 10;

a.request: For every invoice, including those with no line items (count 0, no average), show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its number of line items. List the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest.
a.sql:
SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
GROUP BY i.invoice_number
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number
LIMIT 10;

b.request: For each invoice, show its invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its line-item count; include invoices with no line items, showing a count of 0, and rank all invoices by line-item count from most to fewest.
b.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(ili.order_item_id) DESC) AS line_item_count_rank FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number
